<!-- pr-reviewer: 26311d4887a4e09b9ef0067f85b547ed5edb0923 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is a delta review of `09c5b80be..26311d488`. It checks the one new commit: `fix(post): refuse unsupported Mach4 cycle dwells`. The review before this one (at head `09c5b80be`) stays valid for the rest of the PR.

### The three earlier requests are resolved
1. A cycle dwell no longer drops silently. `assets/posts/mach4.cps:784-787` refuses a positive dwell on `G73/G83/G84/G85/G86` by cycle name, before the cycle block is written. `onCycle` is the only cycle emitter; the post defines no `onCyclePoint`, `onCycleEnd` or `onDwell` hook, so the refusal emits no cycle output at all.
2. The post now writes `P` only on `G82` and `G89` (`assets/posts/mach4.cps:808`). A refused cycle never reaches the writer.
3. The dwell unit now has a cited source. `docs/decisions/1968-mach4-post.md` names the Mill Programming Guide edition and sections for the seconds rule, and says what the operator must do if the control reads `P` in milliseconds.

### Results (merged with main `a8bb30f0c`, built locally, Windows)
| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge with current main | clean, no conflicts |
| `camcraft-post --test mach4_post` | 6 passed (3 new) |
| `camcraft-post --test mach4_trunnion` | 7 passed |
| `camcraft-post --test script_mach4` | 11 passed |
| `camcraft-post --test g83_dwell` | 7 passed |
| `camcraft-post --test cycle_hop` | 7 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test conformance` | 7 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test mach4_builtin` | 2 passed |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The new pins verify the refusals: each refused cycle gives the warning `canned cycle <G> cannot write a dwell on Mach4`, emits no `<G>` line, and posts with zero dwell and no `P`. `mach4_supported_cycle_dwells_use_seconds_on_g82_and_g89_only` shows `P0.25` from a 250 ms dwell on `G82` and `G89`. Mutation check: I disabled the refusal at `mach4.cps:784`; both refusal tests failed; the restore made them pass. The `DRILL`/`SPOT` mapping to `G82` only when dwell is positive is unchanged. `camcraft-app` clippy was not re-run: the delta changes no app source.

### Notes (not blocking)
- A `BACKBORE` with zero dwell writes `G89` with no `P`. The cited manual format shows `P` as part of `G89`. Consider `P0` or `G85` there later. Same for a `PECK`/`DEEP` cycle with no positive `Q`.
- The author's own agent posted a `pr-reviewer` marker on this head. This delta review by an agent that did not write the change is the independent review (AGENTS.md "Only collaborators' reviews count").
- The PR body still says the registry line is in `crates/app/src/posting.rs`. It is in `crates/app/src/posting_files.rs`. The "stacked on #2162" note is satisfied: #2162 is merged.
- Not exercised: a run on a Mach4 control or simulator.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
